ambiguities: The research-only multi-leg block records instrument kind, side, role, target notional fraction, shared eligibility, and leg assumptions, but has no paired-order atomicity, concrete instrument mapping, venue, collateral, margin, settlement, reconciliation, or liquidation semantics. It MUST NOT be interpreted as executable.

The validator accepts only OHLCV inputs. close is retained solely for schema compatibility; funding rate and spot/perpetual basis are out-of-schema indicator sources whose point-in-time availability is not mechanically validated.
The retained configuration was selected from a dependent parameter grid. Search lineage and effective independent-trial count are incomplete, so the numeric DSR result is method-blocked.
Capital allocation, collateral location, margin mode, liquidation distance, rehedging threshold, concentration limits, and venue-specific contract semantics are unresolved.
No observed fills or empirical paper-versus-backtest divergence exist; the 24 bps cost stress is a fixed assumption, not G12 evidence.
assumptions: signal evaluated at the aligned 8-hour bar close after the current funding settlement; any position change occurs only for the following period
warm-up: no eligibility signal until 21 settled funding observations exist for the pair
the 21-period lookback, zero threshold, and 3-period rebalance are the retained research configuration, not validated optimal parameters

the 4 bps toggle cost is the basis-backtest proxy and 24 bps is a static stress assumption; neither is empirical execution evidence
public Binance archive data is an input source only and does not select or authorize Binance or any other execution venue

execution_assumptions: Target notional is one fraction of pair capital before any capital, collateral, fee, or reserve model.
The spot instrument shares the eligible symbol's base and quote assets; concrete venue mapping, fill, and settlement mechanics are unresolved.
Target perpetual notional equals the spot target at entry; contract multiplier, mark/index behavior, and dynamic delta drift are unresolved.
Funding receipt assumes short-side entitlement to positive settled funding; venue margin, settlement, and liquidation mechanics are unmodeled.

failure_modes: Funding reverses or is repriced before the hedge earns the expected payment.
Spot and perpetual basis diverge, especially intraperiod beyond the sampled 8-hour closes.
One leg fills, rejects, liquidates, delists, or becomes unavailable before the other can be hedged or unwound.
Collateral segregation, margin rules, settlement definitions, or contract specifications differ from the research assumptions.
Fees, spread, slippage, impact, latency, or rehedging turnover consume the carry.
Missing-data handling or a survivor-only universe suppresses losses and overstates diversification.
Shared venue, stablecoin, legal, operational, custody, or counterparty failure creates correlated loss.
Grid selection and dependent trials inflate Sharpe or the deflated-Sharpe diagnostic.

instruments.leverage: Unlevered-notional research assumption only; collateral and liquidation are not modeled.

kill_conditions: Any unresolved reconciliation, orphan leg, unexplained PnL, stale data, venue incident, or risk-limit breach.
Any loss of approval, execution isolation, credential isolation, monitoring, or deterministic flatten capability.
Observed paper/backtest divergence exceeds approved G12 tolerances after G12 is validly authorized and run.
no_trade_conditions: Any execution, security, validation, risk, venue, or nondelegable human gate is absent.
Either leg, its point-in-time funding/basis data, or its contract metadata is missing, stale, ambiguous, or not aligned.
The trailing settled-funding mean is not strictly above the configured threshold.
Two-leg atomicity or a proven asymmetric-fill unwind cannot be guaranteed.
Available capital, collateral, margin headroom, liquidity, or venue health is unknown or below approved limits.
Expected funding after empirically measured fees, spread, slippage, latency, and rehedging cost is not positive.
Basis, mark/index divergence, liquidation distance, concentration, or counterparty exposure breaches approved limits.
risk.objective: Test whether positive perpetual-funding carry survives basis movement and costs in a fully hedged long-spot/short-perp basket.

portfolio_limits.concentration_limit: Unspecified; must be defined before any promotion.
portfolio_limits.correlation_limit: Unspecified; shared venue, quote-asset, and crypto-beta concentration remain.

promotion_gates: Freeze point-in-time data and complete immutable lineage, including delisted/missing symbols and the full search hierarchy.
Resolve effective independent trials and rerun G10; the current numeric DSR is method-blocked and is not a PASS.
Implement and independently validate capital, collateral, margin, liquidation, settlement, rehedging, and missing-data models.
Measure venue-specific fills and G12 divergence only in a separately approved paper lane.
Obtain all applicable nondelegable human, security, risk, venue, and capital approvals before any venue connection.

universe.eligibility: Both aligned spot and perpetual 8-hour closes and a settled funding observation must exist; the trailing 21-period funding mean must be positive.

ambiguities: MAJOR SEMANTIC COLLAPSE (flagged prominently): Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) rank stocks CROSS-SECTIONALLY into deciles by trailing return and go long the winner decile / short the loser decile, rebalancing monthly over a 3-12 month formation period. This project's canonical spec has no cross-sectional/portfolio-ranking primitive -- only single-instrument threshold rules. This item approximates the paper's winner-decile membership as 'this instrument's own trailing return > 0', which captures the SIGN of momentum but drops the RELATIVE-RANKING mechanism entirely. This is a genuine incompatible-semantics finding, not a minor reading choice.
the paper's monthly rebalance/holding-period cadence is collapsed to per-bar continuous evaluation, since this project's fixture/dataset resolution is sub-daily, not monthly
